audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes Karma's root to 'RQ' — Mantra-empowered Q — in whys[3], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1]. The root is Focused Resolve (W), a 12s flat tether; Mantra W extends the root and heals her. Mantra Q (Inner Flame) is an extra delayed cataclysm of damage, no root. Separately, Smoke Screen is called a blind in six places — it reduces sight range, deals impact magic damage and briefly slows.
audit.why: Baiting the wrong button is the whole matchup: a player waiting out 'RQ' will step in while her actual 12s W root is up, get tethered, and die. And nothing about her poke misses inside the cloud.
audit.corrected: Root moved to Focused Resolve (W) everywhere with its 12s flat cooldown; Mantra W described as extended root plus self-heal. Every blind restated as sight cut plus slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Graves, Graves, Graves, Skill, Skill, Graves while whys[0] and whys[1] say she pokes you for free with no answer, whys[2] says level 3 only lets you 'contest', and whys[6] says she out-scales you hard. Packet chart is Karma, Karma, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Karma, and the sample is 85 games at 38.82%.
audit.why: Five rows credited Graves with stages the page's own text gives to Karma, on a matchup he loses six games in ten.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Karma, Karma, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Karma with Karma rows at 3/10, even rows at 5/10, and five phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].when says 'Lvl 6+ (her Mantra)'. Riot's text: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point' — it is a 40/38/36/34s cooldown reduced further by her passive Gathering Fire.
audit.why: Telling a player Mantra arrives at 6 means he walks into an empowered Focused Resolve at level 2.
audit.corrected: Window restated as Lvl 1+, and the Mantra pattern described with the abilities it actually empowers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page rates this EVEN at 5.5/10 with a 6/10 carry threat. The Emerald+ figure in the packet is 38.82% over 85 games — the largest sample in this slice.
audit.why: A 39% matchup labelled 'even' tells the player to fight lanes he loses.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 7/10, tone updated, and the two summary lines that quote the numbers rewritten to match.

edits.before: Karma owns levels 1-2 outright — her Q (Inner Flame) out-ranges your whole 4-shell spread and detonates its delayed burst for heavy poke before you can ever close, and you have no E charge yet to dodge or commit. Don't walk into Inner Flame range for a caster minion; eat the CS loss and farm from max distance with the tip of your Q (End of the Line). At 3, two E (Quickdraw) charges finally let you weave in, and W (Smoke Screen) on her face blinds her and shrinks her sight so she can't aim her poke — that's the first moment you stop bleeding for free.
edits.after: Karma owns levels 1-2 outright — her Q (Inner Flame) out-ranges your whole 4-shell spread and detonates its delayed burst for heavy poke before you can ever close, and you have no E charge yet to dodge or commit. Don't walk into Inner Flame range for a caster minion; eat the CS loss and farm from max distance with the tip of your Q (End of the Line). Remember Mantra is live from level 1. At 3, two E (Quickdraw) charges let you weave in and W (Smoke Screen) cuts her sight and slows her so the poke goes wide — the first moment you stop bleeding for free.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 the lane is a knife-fight you can win, but only on her cooldowns. Your entire plan is baiting two abilities: her RQ root (which tethers you so you can never E away) and her E (Inspire) shield + move speed. If both are down, E-in, drop W on her so she's blind, and unload point-blank shells + Q. At 6, Collateral Damage turns a clean engage into a kill — but mistime it into a live shield and root and she kites you to death while her minions chip you down.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 the lane is a knife-fight you can win, but only on her cooldowns. Your entire plan is baiting two abilities: Focused Resolve (W, 12s flat), whose tether roots you if you don't break it, and E (Inspire), her shield plus move speed. If both are down, E-in, drop W on her to cut her sight, and unload point-blank shells + Q. At 6, Collateral Damage turns a clean engage into a kill — but mistime it into a live shield and root and she kites you to death while her minions chip you down.

edits.before: This is where it gets grim. Karma scales into a teamfight enchanter — Mantra RE shields her whole team through your point-blank burst, and RQ roots you out of every engage so your short range never connects. You do not out-1v1 her with items in a straight fight, because she simply never lets you in. Your only real win is having already snowballed: use your E mobility to roam mid and jungle, flank objectives where her team can't peel, and end before her shielding and zone control make your face-DPS irrelevant.

notes: Biggest fix in this slice: the page put Karma's root on 'RQ' (Mantra Q) in eight places. Her root is Focused Resolve (W), 12s flat, and Mantra W extends it and heals her — Mantra Q is a delayed cataclysm of damage only. Also corrected: Mantra is available from level 1, not 6 (spikes[3].when said 'Lvl 6+'), and Smoke Screen does not blind. Level chart flipped to the packet chart; difficulty raised from EVEN 5.5 to TRICKY 7 because the packet's Emerald+ figure is 38.82% over 85 games — the page's own numbers disagreed with its label.
